notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to Rakdos Carnarium.
Rakdos Carnarium does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Rakdos Carnarium.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing Rakdos Carnarium to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Rakdos Carnarium.
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{R}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Rakdos Carnarium.
Repeat.
